obligations.requirement_summary: Synthetic review-only notice requirement; not extracted law

primary_authority.title: AIFM Regulations source locator; synthetic profiles do not state its rules
primary_authority.provision: Index only; reviewer must supply actual applicable provision for deployment

results.rule_coverage: Only the supplied reviewed profiles and explicit entity/activity/product/investor scope

limitations: Geography alone never determines applicability; every profile supplies reviewed entity, activity, product and investor conditions.
Primary URLs and version links are supplied provenance, not authenticated authority or legal interpretation. No universal jurisdiction pack is bundled.
Deadlines are supplied absolute dates; calendar days are descriptive. Business-day calendars, transition relief and discharge require the legal owner.
Different or overlapping profiles are exposed for review; no precedence, extraterritorial rule or stricter standard is inferred.
